**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 03:39  
[EVENT] User is looking for project management tools to help organize tasks more efficiently.  
[EVENT] User has been working on a proposal for a new project on Thursday.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants a tool that can help them stay on track with their proposal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends several project management tools: Trello, Asana, Basecamp, Wrike, ClickUp, Microsoft Planner, and Airtable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trello: A visual project management tool using boards, lists, and cards; great for small to medium-sized projects; has a free version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana: A task-oriented tool for creating and assigning tasks, setting deadlines, and tracking progress; suitable for small to large teams; has a free version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basecamp: A comprehensive project management tool with schedules, tasks, files, and collaboration tools; geared towards small to medium-sized teams; offers a free trial.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wrike: A robust project management tool with Gantt charts, resource allocation, and time tracking; suitable for larger teams; offers a free trial.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ClickUp: An all-in-one project management tool with tasks, Gantt charts, time tracking, and collaboration features; suitable for small to large teams; has a free version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Microsoft Planner: A task management tool that integrates with Microsoft Office 365; great for small to medium-sized teams; included with an Office 365 subscription.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Airtable: A cloud-based database for creating custom tables, forms, and views; suitable for small to medium-sized teams; has a free version.  
[PREFERENCE] User finds Asana interesting and wants to know more about its features and pricing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana features include tasks and subtasks, projects and templates, workflows, due dates and reminders, assignments and roles, collaboration, reporting and dashboards, integrations, and mobile apps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana pricing: Free for small teams (up to 15 users), Premium at $9.99/user/month (billed annually), Business at $19.99/user/month (billed annually), Enterprise with custom pricing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Discounts available for annual billing (10% savings), non-profit organizations (50% discount), and educational institutions (50% discount).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana offers a 30-day free trial for all paid plans.  
[EVENT] User is thinking of using Asana to manage their proposal project.
